summarize_SummarizationInput: summarize text by creating a SummarizationInput with the input text to summarize
create_SummarizationParameters: create SummarizationParameters with truncation strategy and tokenization options for summarization
build_SummarizationOutput: build a SummarizationOutput from inference results containing the summarized text
test_SummarizationInput: test SummarizationInput dataclass with required inputs field and optional parameters
review_SummarizationParameters: review SummarizationParameters dataclass with clean_up_tokenization_spaces and generate_parameters fields
